full_judgment: 4. After partition of India and subsequent emergence of Bangladesh certain circumstances had cropped up and the then Management committee had proposed a modification on the ground due to administrative changes in Bangladesh, the new District Cox's Bazar has been created and Upazila Administration has been introduced and also the limitation of the shrine committee for controlling and managing an by supervising directly all the endowments of the holy shrine and it was essential to form different organizational set up under the shrine committee.
